_comment: Seed questionnaire. Loaded directly when Appwrite is not configured, and used by `npm run appwrite:seed`. After seeding, admins edit questions in /admin — this file is only the starting point. A question's options come from its `dimension`'s values in parameters.json.

questions.title: How many people will participate?
questions.help: The number of participants shapes which designs are feasible. Pick the size closest to your process.

questions.title: What level of public participation are you aiming for?
questions.help: Choose how much influence participants will have over the final decision — from receiving information to holding decision-making power themselves.

questions.title: How can participants take part?
questions.help: The format affects who can join, what the process costs, and the quality of discussion.

questions.title: Who is allowed to participate?
questions.help: This choice affects how representative and inclusive your process is, and how much control you have over who takes part.

questions.title: What demographics do you want to focus on?
questions.help: Select the demographic groups you specifically need to reach. This helps tailor the design to ensure those voices are included.

questions.title: What does your budget allow?
questions.help: Select the resources you can realistically commit to.

questions.title: What are your goals?
questions.help: Rank from most to least important. This ranking determines which process designs are recommended to you.
